full_judgment: 5. Mr. A.K.M. Shafiqur Rahman in support of the Rule urged that the suit being a suit for specific performance of contract the opposite-party having no interest in the land in suit is not at all a necessary party. He further urged that the parties to the agreement are only the other necessary parties to a suit for specific performance of contract. He referred me to the decision is the cases of Prern Sukh Gulgulia and another Vs. Habib Ullah and others, 1945 Cat. 355 and N.T. Palanisamy ChetherVs. Kawara Chettier and others, 1950 Mad. 91. "The necessary parties in a suit for specific performance of a contract for sale are the parties to the contract.
